title: The Forgotten Wolf
author: Bram Eastwick
blurb: Felix Thackeray, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
